metadata.description: Adds ore refining to the game. Compound ores have to be refined before you are able to smelt and cast them into plates. Works best (has more functionality) in conjunction with Angel's industries and/or Bob's mods and supports additional mods like Yuoki Industries.

metadata.name: angelssmelting
metadata.title: Angel's Smelting
metadata.author: Arch666Angel
metadata.description: Angel's Smelting provides alternative ways to produce plate and increase ore yield at the expense of space and energy.

metadata.name: bobassembly
metadata.title: Bob's Assembling machines mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod

This mod adds assembling machines 4, 5 and 6, and updates the recipe for assembling machine 3 to fit my progression pattern.
The mod also adds higher tiers of Electric furnace, Chemical plant and Oil refinery.
It also includes the Electronic assembling machine chain, and additional tiers of machines added by Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates mod.

Designed to work best with my full mod pack.
All additional machine tiers other than assembling machines can be turned off in the mod options.

metadata.name: bobelectronics
metadata.title: Bob's Electronics mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

This mod changes the way you build electronics, making the process more realistic.
First you have to assemble electronic components, then combine them into circuit boards.
Unlike in the base game, each tier of circuit board does NOT require the previous tier.
It also adds a 4th tier of electronics used for high end machinery.

Although it can work by itself, it is designed to function best with my entire set of mods installed.

metadata.name: bobenemies
metadata.title: Bob's Enemies mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Re-adds Alien artifacts to the game.
Adds 6 different coloured versions of artifacts to the game, each based on a different damage type.
Adds small versions of artifacts dropped by biters and spitters.
Adds six new breeds of enemies to the game, in addition to the original vanilla type.
All seven breeds have a full eight tiers of worms, biters, and spitters.
Enemy bases will initially focus on a single breed, before eventually diversifying into having two or three together.
Nearby bases will tend to belong to the same breed, creating territories.
Enemies may have quality boosts.

metadata.name: bobequipment
metadata.title: Bob's Personal Equipment mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Expands the range of equipment available in base mod for the modular armor.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobgreenhouse
metadata.title: Bob's Greenhouse mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

This mod adds a greenhouse, and recipes for it to make wood.
Also an advanced recipe that uses Fertiliser to make even more wood

metadata.name: bobinserters
metadata.title: Bob's Adjustable Inserters mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Adds a GUI for customising inserter pickup/drop positions.

Also adds hot-keys.

SHIFT + P: Change pickup range (Long inserters technology will allow short/long toggle.)
SHIFT + O: Change drop range (Long inserters technology will allow short/long toggle.)
SHIFT + L: Long Inserter toggle (Long inserters technology will allow short/long toggle on both input and output.)
SHIFT + N: Drop location offset toggle (Near inserters technology will allow near/far side of belt toggle)
CTRL + R: Change pickup rotation (4 step rotation by default, More inserters technology will unlock additional directions)
SHIFT + E: Open GUI

All hotkeys can be remapped, and an option exists to open the GUI at the same time as the standard inserter GUI instead of with a hotkey.
This mod also adds in researches to unlock the more adjustment options.

Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zu9LmpZaVPg

metadata.name: boblibrary
metadata.title: Bob's Functions Library mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description: Adds a series of useful functions used by Bob's Mods. These can easilly be used by other mods too.

metadata.name: boblogistics
metadata.title: Bob's Logistics mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Adds lots logistic related things in all areas.
Adds 2 higher tiers of belt and related entities.
Belt overhaul will change all recipes to make better use of Bob mod resources, and add a Tier 0.
Adds a higher tier of inserters.
Inserter overhaul will add more tiers of inserter, replace long handed inserter with a menu to make other inserters long handed, and change all recipes to make better use of Bob mod resources.
If suitable materials are available, it will add 2 higher tiers of chest, and logistic chests
Adds 2 higher tiers of train set (Locomotive, Cargo wagon and Fluid wagon) that will have higher speed and storage. Also adds an armored train set, and Tier 2 version of it.
Adds tier 2 to 4 pumps, and reduces the flow to make the progression work
Adds tier 2 to 4 of Logistic and Construction robots.
Adds tier 2 to 4 roboports, roboport parts (intermediates), and smaller specialised entities, such as the Logistic Zone Expander and Robochest.
Adds tier 2 to 4 of storage tank.
Adds many new pipes made from many different materials, spanning 5 tiers.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobmining
metadata.title: Bob's Mining mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Adds higher tiers of electric mining drill that increase mining speed.
Adds an additional branch of electric mining drills that increase the mining area.
Adds higher tiers of Pumpjacks
Adds a full set of water mining drills, for use with the water patches added by Bob's Ores mod.
Adds several tiers of steel-axe technology to further increase personal mining speed.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobmodules
metadata.title: Bob's Modules mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Expansion to the Modules system.
Expands the 3 types of base game module to be 5 tiers, not just 3
Adjusts the bonuses each module gives, and allows you to customise them in mod settings.
Adds Pollution creating and Pollution cleaning modules, 5 tiers.
God modules provide efficiency + speed + cleaning, with two variants that add either productivity or quality.
All recipes are completely reworked, making use of electronic components from Bob's Electronics mod.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobores
metadata.title: Bob's Ores mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Adds some useful ores, designed for use by Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates mod (MCI).
All ores are disabled by default, MCI will turn on the minimum required ores.
Other mods may make use of these ores.

Ores include, Bauxite(Aluminium), Cobalt, Gems, Gold, Galena(Lead), Nickel, Quartz(Glass, Silicon), Rutile(Titanium), Silver, Sulfur, Thorium, Tin, Tungsten and Zinc.
Also includes Ground water and Lithia water mining fluid nodes, which function similar to Oil.

metadata.name: bobplates
metadata.title: Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.
Designed to make use of resources provided by Bob's Ores mod to function as intended
Other mods may provide an alternate method to obtain the required resources.

This mod is designed as a base to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

This mod adds new production processes including:
  Electrolysis: Seperation of a liquid using electricity.
  Chemical furnace: Heat and a Fluid.
  Mixing furnace: Heat with more than 1 ingredient.
  Liquid pump: Mostly used for Barrelling.
  Gas pump: Used for Bottling, a Barrelling alternative, but also produces the resource Compressed air.
  Gas vent: Disposes of unwanted gasses into the void.

This mod adds a method to produce a metals from resource of the following:
Aluminium, Cobalt, Gold, Lead, Nickel, Glass, Silicon, Titanium, Silver, Tin, Tungsten, Lithium and Zinc.
Alloys of the following:
Bronze, Brass, Gunmetal, Copper-tungsten, Tungsten carbide, Invar, Nitinol and Cobalt-steel.
Also adds a wide array of other materials including Ceramics, Gem processing, and a large array of Liquid and Gas chemicals.
This mod also provides intermediate products including Gear wheels and bearings of multiple materials, Advanced processing units, and 2 tiers of batteries.

metadata.name: bobpower
metadata.title: Bob's Power mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Adds a wide range of power objects, including, but not limited to:
3 sizes and 3 tiers of solar panel.
A full steam power rework so tier 1 of nuclear steam matches tier 3 of regular steam.
5 tiers of steam power.
Oil (burning) boilers added which start at tier 2, and will power 3 steam engines.
nuclear steam power starts at tier 3.
All boiler:steam engine ratios are 2:1 (1 boiler will power 2 steam engines, 1 heat exchanger will power 2 steam turbines)
Nuclear:regular ratios are 2:1. (1 heat exchanger will power 4 steam engines, or 1 boiler will power 1 steam turbine)
4 tiers of medium and large power poles, and substations.
3 tiers, and different types (fast, high capacity, and slow) of Accumulator.
New fluid burning generators that turn oils directly into Electricity.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobrevamp
metadata.title: Bob's Revamp mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

This mod changes some base game areas to better fit with Bob's Mods.
Rocket fuel has been changed to be based on Hydrazine.
Reworked all the rocket based recipes
A rework to how you get Sulfur and Sulfuric acid.
Splits up the oil chain a little, Pumpjack, Chemical plant and Oil refinery are on their own technologies, instead of all in one go.

Intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobtech
metadata.title: Bob's Technology mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

Adds a Lab MK2
Adds Transport science pack, and changes advanced logistic based technologies to cost this new science pack.
If Alien artifacts are enabled from Bob's Enemies mod, an Alien lab and alien science packs are added, plus Science pack Gold made from Science packs 1, 2, 3 and Military.
Science pack ingredients are also changed around, to include some more Bob's Mods resources.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobvehicleequipment
metadata.title: Bob's Vehicle Equipment mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

A range of equipment based on all the modular armor equipment available in base mod.
Up to 6 tiers on most items.
Equipment can be used on the Tank, Locomotive, Cargo and Fluid wagons, and the Artillery wagon.
If Bob's Logistics mod is installed, the equipment can be used on all train vehicles added by it.
If Bob's Warfare mod is installed, the equipment can be used on all tanks and Artillery wagons added by it.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.

metadata.name: bobwarfare
metadata.title: Bob's Warfare mod
metadata.author: Bobingabout
metadata.description:
Requires Bob's functions library mod.

This mod adds a lot of things for warfare.
Adds Nitroglycerine production chain, which is used to make intermediates for new ammo.
Adds 7 new gun ammos, shotgun ammos, and rockets based on an improved normal, and 6 elemental ammos.
Adds a laser rifle and 7 tiers of laser ammo using glass and the 6 gems.
Adds Tanks to tier 3, and artillery wagons to tier 3.
Changes the way you make combat robots, and adds a 4th combat robot capsule.
Adds a Robot laser drone.
Adds a higher tier wall and gate
Adds a couple new mines.
Adds Scatter tank ammo
Adds a few new types of artillery ammo.
Adds more tiers of Radar.

Although it can function as a stand alone mod, it is intended to be used with the full Bob's Mods set.
